about: Fixture map for scripts/check.py: the blocks along the Inn from the Innstadt's west to the Ingling dam (Kraftwerk Passau-Ingling) as scripts/map.json lists them, project rows 1024-3456, columns -1024-2048 (3072 x 2432 m), built: block row 1's three blocks (the west one only its first 384 rows, as on the map), block rows 2 and 3 its two west blocks; the Inn's east bank south of the Innstadt is Austria (no DGM1, no LoD2, no OSM in the Niederbayern extract). All but `name`, `map`, `blocks` and `regions` as in scripts/map.json (pinned for the project).
